item.title: Realm Invader 领域入侵者
item.description:
Realm Invader [Ep.2 P2] [Invader Gary]

Overview

剧情概要

In this game, you follow a young soulless shell for you to self-insert into man who lives in a world very similar to yours. Recently, he’s been riddled with several mysterious ailments, including headaches, goosebumps, and an inexplicable sense of dread.
These symptoms were a warning, this man finds himself in the middle of a cataclysmic event, at least, it would seem so. Where cataclysms will typically lead to the destruction of a world, this one has led to a birth. The nature of his world has shifted around him. There are new species, an altered society, and magic.
He needs to learn about his new circumstances and what he can do with his new magical abilities. This man will slowly come to realize why he was sent to this world and walks a journey to unravel the mystery of his existence.
…
…
…
…
Oh, yeah, and he fucks a bunch of people on the way.

⚠️ PS：关于 AI 幻觉与人工校对

由于 AI 会出现幻觉，文本上下文中，偶尔会出现人名翻译误差、中英文夹杂、以及突兀文风的句子。
目前落谦也只能统一主要角色的人名，但难免还是会有个别遗漏，毕竟落谦只有一个人，时间和精力确实有限。至于一些小名、昵称、缩写称呼、称谓、地点、事件，以及专有名词，还有类似 sister、brother 这种一词多义的单词，则需要人工边玩边修正。当然，如果在统一主要角色人名时，发现了相关专有名词，也会顺手统一一下。还请大家多多谅解，总之不妨碍游玩，如果介意，还请勿玩。

🛡️ 免死金牌

落谦的汉化补丁，无论是AI意译版本还是逐句意译版本，都远不及原文或其他大佬的汉化版本。
与其他汉化大佬不同，落谦并非为了为爱发电 ，而是纯粹希望提升文笔，所以会加入更多文化色彩，比如网络热梗？古诗词？谚语？俗语？网文小说梗？等等？还请高抬贵手，别再阴阳怪气我了。

爱发电 ¥10 / 月（一杯瑞幸咖啡），简润汉化补丁获取，包含后续bug反馈与补丁优化。

关于AI简润汉化补丁
🛠️ 1. 大模型与文风

技术底座： 先调用 DeepSeek-V3.1 API 进行批量初翻，再使用 Antigravity (Gemini 3.7 Flash High) 简润，统一校对角色称谓与专有名词，修复初翻幻觉与病句，地道俚语名梗润色；部分UI图片由 Codex (ChatGPT-5.6 Sol) 与 Antigravity (Gemini 3.7 Flash High) 视觉算法渲染P图完成。
关于文风： AI跑出来是什么文风就是什么文风。我个人很喜欢 DeepSeek 和 Gemini 的地道文风；如果追求极致文学级的翻译，圈内也有很多优秀的汉化大佬纯手工精翻，大家各取所需即可。

☕ 2. 为什么采用订阅制？

落谦个人时间精力非常有限，而且我不是为爱发电！不是为爱发电！不是为爱发电！重要的事情说三遍！开订阅制纯粹是为了回血一部分高昂的Token费用、精力的投入以及博客的日常运营成本。
AI简润补丁 不会公开。因为公开的补丁，不仅没人反馈，还要白受各种阴阳怪气，这些大家心知肚明；而订阅支持我的水友不仅真诚尊重我的劳动，也更愿意主动交流反馈bug，毕竟是真金白银订阅的，哈哈。

💰 3. 实打实的算力成本

调 API 跑测试，DeepSeek V3.1 的单次费用是 V3 的两倍以上。对于某些游戏，如果每次版本更新作者都大修了大批文本，由于精力有限，我都会选择重新跑一次AI。
对于一些我个人特别喜欢的游戏，为了后续做精润，我会人工根据不同模型、不同文风跑出来的几个版本进行对比融合，提炼出最符合角色人设、最接地气且有金句的优质文本。这样反复跑下来，单部游戏的 API 成本少则五六十元，多则（如果用 V3.1 重跑多遍）成本会直接飙升至 上百甚至好几百。
所以 ¥10 / 月（一杯瑞幸咖啡）的订阅真的就是白菜价，成本完全透明。大家可以自行去 DeepSeek 官网或中转站查看输入/输出以及缓存命中的 Token 资费，也可以自己调用 API 跑几个游戏测试一下。博客已有上百部 AI 意译补丁，订阅水友如果想让我做哪部游戏的AI 简润，欢迎随时向我投稿推荐！

item.title: Contagion Crisis 传染危机
item.description:
Contagion Crisis [v0.7.0] [WeLoveMonsters]

Overview

剧情概要

Contagion Crisis is an adult monster survival-horror kinetic novel heavily influenced by games such as Resident Evil, Parasite Eve, and more.
In 2018, a contagion escapes into the city of Grimhaven, Washington, turning everything it touches into lust-fueled monsters. Sisters, Sarah and Ava, must traverse the city, doing their best to avoid the mutations as they attempt to reach sanctuary. Through their journey, the pair will seek the truth of the contagion’s outbreak; a task that will require them to unravel a web of lies that will change them both forever.​

item.title: Murmur 低语
item.description:
Murmur [v0.7 Hotfix] [Devil’s Dad]

Overview

剧情概要

It is a story about love and lust in our lives, about what their absence leads to and what forms they can take. In this game, you’ll be playing as a 29-year-old guy who gets involved in unexpected mystical events. His life gets turned on its head and he has to survive in the new world he’s found himself in. But it’s not as grim as it seems at first glance. As you play, you’ll meet girls who need you just like you need them. Will you make them yours, seduce them, or cherish and love them? It’s up to you. Each of them has their own background, character, and hidden fetishes…​

Details

游戏信息

游戏玩法

视觉小说

建模引擎

Honey Select 2

运行引擎

Ren’Py

游戏画风

亚洲风

当前版本

0.7 Public Hotfix

发行日期

2025-05-15

Developer（入正地址）

Itch.io Patreon Discord

落谦酱便利贴

PS

很纯很暧昧，这游戏玩下来很甜，尤其结衣甜得犯规，而且文风很舒服，男主人设也三观在线，没粗话，没damn，情商很高，总得来说，作者文笔很强，不尬，设定也好。 目前在我这里排第四，虽然女主有种日漫番剧倒贴的既视感，嗯，没错，就是成人版的五等分的花嫁，但是我就好这一口，我玩完futa，ntl，女性堕落，再来一把这个，简直太带派了。

由于 AI 会出现幻觉，文本上下文中，偶尔会出现人名翻译误差、中英文夹杂、以及突兀文风的句子。
目前落谦也只能统一主要角色的人名，但难免还是会有个别遗漏，毕竟落谦只有一个人，时间和精力确实有限。至于一些小名、昵称、缩写称呼、称谓、地点、事件，以及专有名词，还有类似 sister、brother 这种一词多义的单词，则需要人工边玩边修正。当然，如果在统一主要角色人名时，发现了相关专有名词，也会顺手统一一下。还请大家多多谅解，总之不妨碍游玩，如果介意，还请勿玩。

🛡️ 免死金牌

落谦的汉化补丁，无论是AI意译版本还是逐句意译版本，都远不及原文或其他大佬的汉化版本。

关于AI简润汉化补丁
🛠️ 1. 大模型与文风

技术底座： 先调用 DeepSeek-V3.1 API 进行批量初翻，再使用 Antigravity (Gemini 3.7 Flash High) 简润，统一校对角色称谓与专有名词，修复初翻幻觉与病句，地道俚语名梗润色；部分UI图片由 Codex （ChatGPT-5.6 Sol） 视觉算法渲染P图完成。
关于文风： AI跑出来是什么文风就是什么文风。我个人很喜欢 DeepSeek 和 Gemini 的地道文风；如果追求极致文学级的翻译，圈内也有很多优秀的汉化大佬纯手工精翻，大家各取所需即可。

☕ 2. 为什么采用订阅制？

落谦个人时间精力非常有限，而且我不是为爱发电！不是为爱发电！不是为爱发电！重要的事情说三遍！开订阅制纯粹是为了回血一部分高昂的Token费用、精力的投入以及博客的日常运营成本。
AI简润补丁 不会公开。因为公开的补丁，不仅没人反馈，还要白受各种阴阳怪气，这些大家心知肚明；而订阅支持我的水友不仅真诚尊重我的劳动，也更愿意主动交流反馈bug，毕竟是真金白银订阅的，哈哈。

💰 3. 实打实的算力成本

调 API 跑测试，DeepSeek V3.1 的单次费用是 V3 的两倍以上。对于某些游戏，如果每次版本更新作者都大修了大批文本，由于精力有限，我都会选择重新跑一次AI。
对于一些我个人特别喜欢的游戏，为了后续做精润，我会人工根据不同模型、不同文风跑出来的几个版本进行对比融合，提炼出最符合角色人设、最接地气且有金句的优质文本。这样反复跑下来，单部游戏的 API 成本少则五六十元，多则（如果用 V3.1 重跑多遍）成本会直接飙升至 上百甚至好几百。
所以 ¥10 / 月（一杯瑞幸咖啡）的订阅真的就是白菜价，成本完全透明。大家可以自行去 DeepSeek 官网或中转站查看输入/输出以及缓存命中的 Token 资费，也可以自己调用 API 跑几个游戏测试一下。博客已有上百部 AI 意译补丁，订阅水友如果想让我做哪部游戏的AI 简润，欢迎随时向我投稿推荐！

item.title: Lucid 清醒
item.description:
Lucid [v0.10] [MissFit]

Overview

剧情概要

Lucid is a game about dreams and how celestial beings called Lunes interact with them.
Lunes look exactly like humans, but they interact with dreams in a very curious manner.
They could foresee the future and even change their fate through their dreams.
Aside from their special abilities involving dreams, Lunes are also naturally gifted mentally and physically.
People in the old days feared them, so they decided to keep their race a secret.
Our story is about a young orphan Lune who is just, trying to survive everyday life but will soon discover that life is not as simple for a Lune like him, especially since he doesn’t fully know his race or himself.
He may already be a Lune, and that alone makes him unique, but he is actually more special than the other Lunes.
Let’s just say he has a very big advantage in finding a suitable partner in life.​

item.title: Legends of ETERIA: TheChronos 埃特里亚的传奇：克瑞诺斯
item.description:
Legends of ETERIA: TheChronos [v0.1] [Tio Cuba]

Overview

剧情概要

LEGENDS OF ETERIA: THECHRONOS is an 18+ fantasy visual novel filled with harem chaos and cosmic mystery. Chronos wasn’t chosen by the gods—he died in his own world, survived the Void, and woke up in Eteria with every memory intact… and now Nexura—the Goddess and Queen of All Curses—is trapped inside him.

Spoiler: More

Eteria doesn’t go easy on newcomers. Beneath its modern surface lie guilds, Zero Portals, clans, hidden races, and an energy known as Bioessence—powerful enough to open impossible paths or turn you into prey. Chronos wields Limit Breaker, a rule-shattering power that has no business being that strong. The problem? He starts at E-rank with no control, more nerve than experience, and a talent for getting in over his head.
At Luminar Academy, between missions, spectacular screwups, dirty jokes, adult tension, and grown women carrying secrets of their own, Chronos must learn to survive without drawing too much attention. Nexura isn’t inside him by accident—and understanding why may be the only way to keep countless realities from being damned.

这款游戏也停更了好久，不知道还更不更，上次更新已经是两年前了。我之前用V3模型跑了AI玩了一下，但是玩了一半头很痛，主要是渲染太黄了，而且建模也是童颜巨乳，看得有点难绷。
所以我也不知道什么时候更新，就顺便做一下吧。抛去我刚刚说的那些，其实质量还是蛮高的。同类型题材还有一个《低语》，其实我更喜欢《低语》，那个比较日系一点，这个比较东南亚风一点。
总之就这样子吧，我最近用了V3.1模型重新跑了一次，其实跑的时候还测试错了，因为我最近在Vide Coding的一个工具嘛，要测试，测试提取文本，提取翻译啊，不过提取失误，跑完AI才发现，导致浪费了二三十块钱跑了一堆废文本，唉，说多都是泪。
然后我也用反重力也就是Gemini 3.7 Flash跑了一些图片，用算法重新渲染P图，烧了1%的周额度，还是挺便宜的，不过呢，有些没有背景图的就渲染的很好，有些有背景图的就直接模糊打上中文了。总之就这样子吧，要什么自行车呢？对吧？
其实我还想再做一个选项mod跟作弊mod，但这游戏已经自带选项mod，所以就没去做那个F95的小丑mod。等下次更新再做一个作弊mod吧。其实做不做弊都没关系，打开画廊mod就能看全画廊了。

这次没九龙抱柱，九龙抱柱已经陨落了，用V3模型花费一坤元，0.1-0.7从头到尾跑出来的AI意译，原汁原味，落谦只是七七八八修了一下专有名词，我是一句话都不敢改啊！！！被喷怕了！！！放过孩子吧！！！
这次0.9版本，我使用V3.1模型从头开始跑，顺便测试了一下我最近用Codex和Antigravity Vibe coding的一个翻译工具，速度还是蛮快的，半个小时跑完了。
烧了13块钱的token有点小贵啊，主要是我在工具里加了一个可以候选专有名词啊，就是每一次输送给模型的文本都会候选一下专有名词，但是这一个步骤是会消耗token的，所以会贵个一两块，速度也会慢一点点，不然的话可能20分钟就跑完了。
那至于为什么用V3.1模型？因为之前V3跑这个异世界的时候，或者是古言题材、奇幻题材，就会出现幻觉，变得文绉绉的，不过用V3.1就比较稳定了。
还有就是说，我现在不是这个游戏的官中，我之前也没有意愿接这官中。只是当初我加那些梗，只为在音符那里来直播整整活，圈点小token而已。不知道接官中还得向所谓的圈内人打报告，算是我个人问题。而且我当初该道歉的道歉，官中该推的推也都推了。麻烦你们圈内大佬管好你们的小弟，每一次发这个破游戏，就会有一群未成年来冲我，我真的搞不懂。我自认自己没有那种实力，不用再阴阳怪气我了，阴阳怪气我真没用。

item.title: Inanna Revenge 伊南娜的复仇
item.description:
Inanna Revenge [v0.4.4] [AtemX Games]

Overview

剧情概要

In Inanna Revenge, you play as Arthur (customizable name), a 21-year-old young man living a dull and uneventful life with his stepsister—until one fateful day, that life comes to an abrupt end. But death doesn’t mark the end of your journey. A goddess named Ea offers you a chance to be reincarnated into a new world, one brimming with magic and adventure. What seems like the beginning of a fairy tale quickly reveals a harsher reality. To carve out your place in this new world, you’ll need to fight, face countless challenges, make tough decisions, and build meaningful relationships. Will you rise to the occasion, or be consumed by the trials ahead?

Spoiler

In Inanna Revenge, you won’t just control your character’s relationships with others, but also shape his personal development. Numerous choices allow you to develop your character into someone compassionate or ruthless, depending on your preferences. These choices will influence how your character interacts with others in various situations. Moreover, you can also affect the mentality of some of your love interests, deciding whether to pursue a romantic relationship with them or guide them into becoming submissive, obedient companions.
The game is a Visual Novel with a strong RPG feel. A turn-based combat system will be used to resolve certain conflicts, and your characters will gain levels, allowing them to allocate stat points and learn new skills. You’ll also find puzzles to solve later in the game.

关于汉化补丁

🤖 AI 模型：DeepSeek-V3

✍️ 翻译作者：落谦

📅 制作日期：2026-08-07

⚠️ PS：关于 AI 幻觉与人工校对

由于 AI 会出现幻觉，文本上下文中，偶尔会出现人名翻译误差、中英文夹杂、以及突兀文风的句子。

目前落谦也只能统一主要角色的人名，但难免还是会有个别遗漏，毕竟落谦只有一个人，时间和精力确实有限。至于一些小名、昵称、缩写称呼、称谓、地点、事件，以及专有名词，还有类似 sister、brother 这种一词多义的单词，则需要人工边玩边修正。当然，如果在统一主要角色人名时，发现了相关专有名词，也会顺手统一一下。还请大家多多谅解，总之不妨碍游玩，如果介意，还请勿玩。

🛡️ 免死金牌

落谦的汉化补丁，无论是AI意译版本还是逐句意译版本，都远不及原文或其他大佬的汉化版本。

与其他汉化大佬不同，落谦并非为了为爱发电 ，而是纯粹希望提升文笔，所以会加入更多文化色彩，比如网络热梗？古诗词？谚语？俗语？网文小说梗？等等？还请高抬贵手，别再阴阳怪气我了。

落谦酱点评

游戏预览图

素图

DOWNLOAD（汉化补丁）

PS必看
⚡ 插曲

先说个事儿啊，这次更新的速度比较慢，因为我家早上电路烧了导致停电，一直搞到 10 点钟才修好。我昨天本来 1 点多就早早睡了，结果因为停电没空调，6 点多直接被热醒了，我操！

🤖 尝鲜

然后汉化这块怎么说呢，我本来试着用 DeepSeek V3 去跑（用的是硅基流动，因为官网已经没 V3 了），结果发现一直请求失败，被限制了。所以我就用了昨天刚发布的 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 正式版。

之前我用过它的预览版，跑出来的效果差强人意，但是这次用正式版感觉还行，跑得挺快的。这次文本更新量比较大，原本用 V3 可能要跑一个小时，花费两块半；用了 V4 Flash 跑得挺快，大概就花了二三十分钟，才 3 毛钱，还是比较便宜的。这模型比较屌，毕竟昨天刚发布，一群搞测试的都在吹，所以我就先拿来用一下。如果大家觉得这版质量跑得不好，我们晚上等硅基流动没那么挤了，再跑一个 V3 版本的。

🤷‍♂️ 妥协

总之目前就这样子。其实说实话，我是 不太想制作这个游戏的，为什么呢？因为游戏比较热门，有很多人第一时间就跑了 AI，甚至有大佬做了精翻，我也不想去献丑。

但是有好几位水友一直让我跑这个，他们也没有别的资源，只能拿我的。我想了想，不做的话确实挺不厚道的，所以就帮他们做一下吧。

💔 杂音

但是我每次做这种热门游戏，都会被人喷。有的人就说：“你他妈的，你自己都不玩，那跑出来干嘛呢？卧槽！有 bug 不修，有幻觉不修……”还要抓着我一顿喷。

你说遇到这种搞我心态、一直阴阳怪气的，我是 真不想弄这些。你们看我每次在博客更新的都是一些玩的人比较少的冷门游戏，反倒没人喷我，因为他们不玩呗，基本都是 真正想玩的水友在玩。

📌 底线

还有就是关于之前 4.6 版本的肖恩模组，这次 肖恩模组还没更新，等更新之后我们再把剩下的补上吧。

所以有问题大家可以 正常反馈。但你要是他妈的喷我，那我就不做！你越喷我越不做，就这样子吧！

完整体modMod

item.title: Mayfly 蜉蝣
item.description:
Mayfly [v0.3 Reset] [JasonTon]

Overview

游戏概述

“I eneath the streets of this city, the smell of blood and rust lingers. Portraits of the powerful hang everywhere, trying to cover up their crimes.”

Spoiler

Devon. The world’s only mega-city. A place where splendor and squalor, order and chaos… every contradiction lives side by side. You might find gold on every corner, but don’t ignore the corpses it’s piled upon. Superpowers touch only a few, and most of them use that power for selfish gain. The government, at its wits’ end, had to let private corporations handle security, giving rise to all sorts of “vigilantes.” Not all of them are out for justice. You’ll need to watch carefully… Yeah, the only person you can trust is yourself. The government didn’t give up control entirely. They formed a secret police force of superhumans called the “Bounty Hunters.” They’re the more vicious, more powerful claws of the state. What will you choose? To drown in this dazzling city of sin, or… to become a dying lamp lighting the way forward? It’s tough. Your companions have their own ideas too. Maybe every choice you make with them will twist the world’s fate. “Will you live a mayfly’s brief life in this gilded metropolis, or carve an eternal legend into the streets?” “After all the suffering, is what awaits you truly light and warmth?”

关于汉化补丁
  • AI模型：DeepSeek-V3
  • 翻译作者：落谦
  • 制作日期：2026-07-01
  • PS：由于AI会出现幻觉，那么文本上下文中，偶尔会出现人名翻译误差、中英文夹杂、以及突兀文风的句子。目前落谦也只能统一主要角色的人名，但难免还是会有个别遗漏，毕竟落谦只有一个人，时间和精力确实有限。至于一些小名、昵称、缩写称呼、称谓、地点、事件，以及专有名词，还有类似sister、brother这种一词多义的单词，则需要人工边玩边修正。当然，如果在统一主要角色人名时，发现了相关专有名词，也会顺手统一一下。还请大家多多谅解，总之不妨碍游玩，如果介意，还请勿玩。
  • 免死金牌：落谦的汉化补丁，无论是AI意译版本还是逐句意译版本，都远不及原文或其他大佬的汉化版本。与其他汉化大佬不同，落谦并非为了为爱发电 ，而是纯粹希望提升文笔，所以会加入更多文化色彩，比如网络热梗？古诗词？谚语？俗语？网文小说梗？等等？还请高抬贵手，别再阴阳怪气我了。

item.title: Parallax 视差
item.description:
Parallax [v0.1.2] [Big P]

Overview

剧情概要
  • “No man ever steps in the same river twice, for it’s not the same river, and he is not the same man” In the near future, power doesn’t live in the open. It lives in quiet rooms, deniable operations, and people who can be erased. You are one of those people. Good at the job. Loyal to your squad. Pragmatic about who signs the cheques. Just another professional in a world that runs on people like you. And then everything changes. Parallax is a near-future conspiracy thriller and adult visual novel about identity, control, and the relationships that form in the spaces between missions. The tone aims to be colder and more grounded than most games in the genre, focused on consequence, shifting loyalties, and what people become when they are used as tools.​

item.title: Clown Squad 弄臣本色
item.description:
Clown Squad [v0.1 Part 1] [NoGlory]

Overview

剧情概要
  • The world loves lies — as long as theyâre funny, pretty, or heroic. You were never meant to be honest. You were meant to be a clown. A performer. A distraction. A joke. But thereâs a problem. You physically cannot lie. Jokes are built on exaggeration, nonsense, and falsehood. Comedy is a craft of bending the truth. And you? Youâre forced to tell it exactly as it is. Youâre cynical to your core. You think too sharply. You work harder than anyone around you. Your mind is a razor. And because of it — people treat you worse than someone who has nothing at all. This is a story about a man forced to be funny in a world that hates the truth. And now, for the first time, you get to decide: Will you break or will you break the world?​

item.title: The Nature of Magic 魔法的本质
item.description:
The Nature of Magic [Part 4] [Slate Interactive]

Overview

剧情概要
  • With every passing generation, fewer and fewer are born with the Affinity. Where once every human, elf, and orran could wield magic, now only half of those born to Eorþe’s six Great Families develop the ability. Outside the Families the percentage drops significantly. And worse, a spate of suspicious deaths have left only two men with the Affinity alive, both among the Families: Cymhen Grym and Cyril Cenric. Unknown to all but Cymhen, however, a third lives in secret, shunning the intrigue and exploitation of the Families.
Spoiler
  • The Families are never denied for long, and a threat soon forces Cymhen’s hand. Your old mentor seeks you out and offers you a place with the Gryms. In exchange for their protection, he asks that you aid him in his latest endeavor: to determine the cause of the dwindling number of those born with the Affinity. Will you mend the wounds rent by your sudden disappearance five years ago? Will you stay true to yourself under the weight of the Great Families? Will you discover The Nature of Magic?

PS
  • 修复mod已更新。
  • 至于我们的AI简润补丁可能要推迟了。
  • 短则两三天，长则一个星期啊。
  • 因为润色需要花费很多时间，但现在唯一的问题就是时间，我没有时间
  • 而且我还得再跑两次AI，一共是三次啊。为什么还要跑呢？
  • 之前也说过，AI是会出现幻觉的。那我跑三次，总有一次是不会出现幻觉的。
  • 那我只要把不会出现幻觉的句子东拼西凑，就能拼凑出一些金句
  • 但如果三次都出现幻觉怎么办？只能再花两三倍的token让Codex修复这些出现幻觉的句子
  • 因为没有时间，只能用金钱来解决了
  • 这也就是说我为什么每次只上AI意译版本，然后再使用一些脚本，统一一下专有名词，还有一些人名，再提取一些文本，而没有精润或者是简润
  • 因为是真没有时间啊，做补丁其实很快的，一两个小时就能做一两个。
  • 如果是文本量比较少的，代码没有那么奇怪的，没有那么反人类的。
  • 如果反人类的话，可能要两个小时一个补丁
  • 跑AI的话更简单了，挂在后台跑就行了。
  • 然后再烧点token让Codex盯着
  • 但是Codex又不是万能的，而且每一次提示词都需要烧token，这都是钱包在出血。
  • 而且简润的话需要通过人工来，那么这个时间可能会耗上一个星期或者是半个月那样子，具体还是看这个文本量，
  • 至于精润的话，可能要在这个原先的基础上，费用精力时间乘以七
  • 所以我觉得这些都是非常多此一举的，因为这些视觉小说，既不是名著，又不是神作。花这么大精力、花这么多钱去做这个，我觉得非常不必要
  • 而且大部分都是抄日漫、国漫、韩漫、美漫的，而且还是半成品，随时可以跑路。那我为什么不直接去看日漫、国漫、韩漫、美漫呢？
  • 所以，花百来块钱，再加上半个多月的时间。去做一个补丁，我是接受不了的，是付出跟收入是不成正比的。
  • 我只能接受我花十几块钱，跑两三个AI，然后我简单打个画廊mod看一下画廊剧情就下机了。
  • 况且平心而论，大家玩这种难登大雅的下九流，大多数都是奔着CG来的，谁又是正人君子呢？对吧？
WindowsPC

item.title: DropOut Saga 金盆洗手
item.description:
DropOut Saga [v0.12.0b] [LazyBloodlines]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Your life has been turned upside down since the loss of someone important to you. You’ve distanced yourself from everyone and lived in isolation, consumed by grief. But you’ve always put on a brave face for the outside world. Showing weakness was never an option. As a member of the mob, you’ve faced countless challenges that have taken a toll on you. You’ve been tasked with infiltrating an exclusive educational institution where the children of powerful politicians are enrolled. But the ghosts of your past are still haunting you, and your sins continue to weigh heavily on your conscience. Will you succumb to the seductive lure of the life of sin that you’ve been trying so hard to leave behind? The stakes are high, and the clock is ticking. It’s time to make a choice.​

item.title: Slatford 斯莱特福德
item.description:
Slatford [v0.03] [Aapek]

Overview

剧情概要
  • You live in a modest house in the city of Slatford alongside your grandmother. The university you attend is located there, and you’re nearing the end of your studies, so you’re determined to make this your big year.k the amount owed. And many others will always help you when needed. And then, you realize… you have to live in a harsh world, not the wonderful one as many people think this is.​
Spoiler
  • Your actions will determine your fate. What would you be willing to do for someone you care about? Your biggest challenge won’t be passing a final exam or kissing your ideal girl. There’s no room for the weak here; you’ll be judged in a city of malice. But don’t worry, there are pleasant situations and romance aplenty. Each character is unique in their own way, providing you with a variety of options to choose from. Slatford will be the epicenter of your adventures. Make sure to read the looks, phrases, and environments carefully. You won’t be safe, and neither will your friends. Be prudent; some people will like you more than others. Your choices may lead you down different paths. What will you become? Are you brave enough to enter this endless maze of mysteries? If so, I wish you luck. You’ll need it.

item.title: Divinity 神性
item.description:
Divinity [Update 2] [toasterkun]

Overview

剧情概要
  • You were sent to this land to protect your Sister as she tends to them, bringing forth Our glory to its inhabitants.. That is, if you believe her words… Divinity is an erotic Adult Visual Novel with horror themes set in a fantasy, late medieval setting. The Player Character is a divine being who was sent to protect his Sister (if you believe her words…) as she opens a portal between their world and the land inhabited by these animals.​

Details

PS
  • 这游戏非常抽象，具体怎么抽象法，大家玩一下就知道了。只能说白瞎了这么好的建模，渲染去做这种究极谜语人，看不懂的，什么都看不懂啊。
  • 你们自己试一下，然后这游戏已经是两年没更新了，我也不知道它更不更新啊。
  • 还有就是有些文本是显示不了汉化的，那个得去改原代码，尽管我已经把所有文本都给提取出来，对，没听错，是所有文本，我把剩下那些抽取的文本啊，全都塞到一个rpy文件里边了，就没有去排序了，因为文本量比较少，文件也比较少，而且大多都是讲一些奇奇怪怪的东西，我不想去弄这游戏了。
  • 其实我是想用那个replace代码进行一键替换的，但是之前那个素晴同人也是一键替换，导致出现了bug，现在都还没修好。也是没有时间修，所以我这里就不去加那个了，等一下又出现什么bug，又要搞好久的，那简直就是什么，捡芝麻丢西瓜的了

item.title: Regrets 后悔
item.description:
Regrets [v0.2.0] [Pligh]

Overview

剧情概要
  • A future world - where everything develops quickly and especially in Medicine. With just one pill, all the wounds will be healed immediately. And right now, you’re living in that amazing world. But ironically, your parents, they have disappeared for no reason. Only to make your life more difficult because you have to pay off the debt left by your parents. You thought everything was deadlocked. But with a glimpse of hope shining on you, you have been adopted by Cara and together you have paid back the amount owed. And many others will always help you when needed. And then, you realize… you have to live in a harsh world, not the wonderful one as many people think this is.​

  • You play as Akuma (nameable), a half-demon hiding on Earth after escaping the war-torn realm of Eldoria. But peace never lasts. As demonic forces rise, you’re pulled back into the very conflict you once fled. Prepare for action, mystery, and seduction as you uncover the dark secrets buried in your bloodline—and face the destiny you tried to escape.

PS
  • 怎么说呢？很可惜的一个游戏啊，我去年还给它精润过，但由于加的梗还有点多，好像有七八个，我也忘记了。
  • 而且补丁不知道被我放到哪里去了，所以又只能跑一个AI啊。
  • 现在说说游戏吧，游戏是虽然有很多日漫角色在那里边，但是怎么说呢？作者，呃，做到一半，不能说一半吧？就是胎死腹中了，0.1就不做了，去做另外一个游戏。
  • 虽然剧情有点老套啊，男主也是下半身思考的动物。但是渲染动画做的确实挺好的呀。你都下半身思考了，你直接做几个爽文剧情，再做点CG，反正你们那边一大堆日漫角色，什么明日香啊、雏田啊，甚至还有永恒世界的茶的客串，不好吗？然后搞点什么真命天子之类，给个系统之类的，你直接跑去做那个什么镜头欲望，看不明白。

item.title: K-Tycoon 我的韩国顶流后宫生活
item.description:
K-Tycoon [v0.1] [Cinder]

Overview

剧情概要
  • K-Tycoon is an idol-themed, story-focused harem game where you live the dual life, of the undisputed playboy king of the K-pop industry.
剧情概要
  • On stage, you are the perfect celebrity — impossibly handsome, charming, and adored by millions of fangirls. You wave to screaming crowds, deliver chart-topping hits, and project the image of a sweet, innocent heartthrob the world fell in love with. You have conquered the artificial world of the K-pop industry with all that fame brings. But behind the cameras and flashing lights lies a much more dangerous and intoxicating reality than meets the eye. As you reach the absolute peak of your career, the carefully constructed walls you thought would protect you forever begin to crack. Corporate politics, rivals, changes in the industry, new people, hidden desires, and fresh opportunities pull you deeper into a world where intimacy and success come with real consequences — emotional, personal, and more often than not irreversible. How will you navigate the complex web of romance, mystery, desire, and corruption that remains hidden from the public’s eye? Well, the answer is only up to you.

item.title: Eternum 永恒世界
item.description:
Eternum [v0.9.5 Public] [Caribdis]

Overview

剧情概要
  • You’re moving with your best friend to the city of Kredon, home to some of the best schools and universities in the country, to continue your studies. However, in Kredon, there’s only one thing everyone talks about: ETERNUM—the virtual, hyper-reality MMORPG game released a few years ago that revolutionized the world of technology.
Spoiler
  • With a neural implant that recreates the five senses, it becomes impossible to distinguish between the game and the real world. Thousands of servers form the network of Eternum: from colorful, magic-filled fantasy worlds to foggy sci-fi cities, no world is beyond reach. Nevertheless, looking beyond the surface, there’s a darker side to this pretty facade: black markets, torture, rape, illegal content trafficking, unlawful assemblies, data theft… Eternum follows the rules of no man. For some reason, governments turn a blind eye to this; there’s no regulation and no control. Some say it’s because the game is highly addictive, some say it’s because the market moves millions of dollars daily, some say those in power have been bribed, and others say… there’s something else going on. And you? What’s your role in this story? Well… That’s up to you now.

item.title: My Bully Is My Lover 我的爱人是恶女
item.description:
My Bully Is My Lover [Ch.2 Ep.2] [NiiChan]

Overview

剧情概要
  • In this emotionally charged narrative-driven game, you step into the shoes of a protagonist who has endured the scars of high school bullying. Haunted by memories of a girl who made life unbearable, you’ve journeyed through both literal and metaphorical realms of heaven and hell, reshaping your identity and vowing for retribution. Yet, as adulthood dawns, you realize the futility of clinging to past grudges and choose a path of moving forward.
Spoiler
  • But fate has a twist in store. Your tranquil life is upended when the same high-school bully, along with her friends become your housemates, thanks to your landlady’s new rental arrangements. Unprepared and unnerved, you brace for a resurgence of old conflicts. However, what unfolds is a journey far more profound and unexpected.
  • “My Bully is My Lover” is more than a game; it’s a journey of healing, understanding, and the unexpected ways of life intertwine. Prepare to embark on a path where past pain paves the way for growth and unlikely bonds.

item.title: Bloody Anomaly 血腥异常
item.description:
Bloody Anomaly [v0.2] [Dejavu]

Overview

剧情概要
  • The outbreak of the BA26 virus claimed thousands of lives and temporarily wiped out the usual rules. A vaccine with 93% effectiveness restored the illusion of safety, but you were unlucky, one of the 7% for whom it didn’t work… Well… there was no turning back.
  • Rumors spread that some of the infected were exhibiting strange, almost vampiric behavior.
Spoiler: More
  • Journalist Sera wrote: “They could no longer eat regular food. Their manners, habits, appetite… everything changed. I don’t know what was happening to them, but it was terrifying.”
  • And what about you? Once an orphan with nothing in your pocket, you clawed your way to the top, building a chemical empire and becoming a millionaire. Power, money, knowledge, everything was in your hands. Risk and criminal connections had long been part of your life, just like the church you built in the heart of the city, a towering mansion disguised as a place of worship.
  • And while the rumors kept spreading, no one knew what would happen next. The first wave may have been only a test, and the real consequences had yet to appear.
  • If the second stage of the virus begins, everything could change overnight. Oh… the vaccine does not work on you… And then you will have to choose: fight to survive or be consumed by the virus with no chance of recovery.

item.title: Sinful Summer 夏日小故事
item.description:
Sinful Summer: A Tale of Forbidden Love [Ch.3.6] [Ruykiru]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Embark on an unforgettable journey with Erik and Lyna, two young twins entangled in a passionate web of desires. Set against the breathtaking backdrop of a private tropical island villa, their reunion after a year abroad sparks a fiery exploration of emotions that defy traditional boundaries.
  • As they tread the line between repressed feelings and mutual attraction, their bond deepens and the craving for the forbidden becomes impossible to ignore. With the arrival of their mother Helga on the horizon, will they succumb to temptation or resist the call of their primal urges? Discover the twists and turns of this compelling narrative through a kinetic visual novel where love, family, and desire intertwine in very interesting ways…
  • DISCLAIMER: THIS IS NOT A GAME, IT’S A VISUAL NOVEL WITHOUT CHOICES.
  • Think of it as a book, TV show or movie, but with lots of porn. Also this is NOT your usual incest story about a mindless poorly-written harem. It has a big focus on the taboo itself and making the family relationships mean something more than just a label. Expect very heavy incestuous dialogue here, without any stupid censorship patches. Also lesbian scenes and both male and female protags.

item.title: Phantyx 幻灵
item.description:
Phantyx [v0.1] [Velrya]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Humans and demons have shared this world for as long as anyone can remember. Their coexistence has been anything but peaceful, and many bloody wars have been fought. Then, suddenly, the demons disappeared.
剧情概要
  • It looked like everything was slowly returning to normal. Then the ghosts appeared. That’s why Phantyx was created, a special taskforce to deal with this new threat.
  • You’re a highly ranked ghost hunter who joined Phantyx at fourteen, following in your parents’ footsteps. With eight years of experience under your belt, you’re known for being quick and efficient, but most of all. Merciless.
  • Because this fight is personal. After your parents were killed, you made a promise: To keep fighting. Until every last ghost is gone. But what will it take to keep that promise?

item.description:
Companion of Darkness [S2 Ch.12.5] [Berkili4]

Overview

剧情概要
  • 3 years after a tragic incident, you return to your hometown. Just before you reach your destination, you watch as two supernatural forces pit their strength against each other in a fight to the death.
  • It seems that you have been discovered and effortlessly overwhelmed, but instead of dying you wake up in your bed as if nothing had happened.
  • Was it all a dream?
  • Everyday life goes on whether you like it to or not. Not only do you feel like a stranger in your hometown, more and more unexplainable events are happening around you.
  • When the ones you care for are threatened, you must decide which boundaries you are willing to cross. And, if it is worth to give up humanity.

item.title: Studio Hearts 心之工作室：公车上锁
item.description:
Studio Hearts [v0.3] [Atemsiel]

Overview

剧情概要
  • In Studio Hearts, you play as Marcus (Or a custom name), a 30 year old Capital Raising Associate living and working in London. He doesn’t get too much time for a personal life as a result of work, and approximately three years before the start of the story, he finds himself filling the void by talking to a camgirl, Mila, whose name can also be customised. She’s a 22 year old woman who’s been solo camming since shortly after her 18th birthday, with it subtly or not so subtly affecting almost all aspects of her life. Her goals, friendships, and even her personality have all been influenced by her work.
剧情概要
  • Over time, she becomes closer to Marcus than any of her other viewers. Close enough to reveal her real location, which she usually keeps secret for her own safety. She lives in the fictional Russian speaking country of Kharzovya, which whilst western in many ways, is also very culturally distinct from what Marcus is used to, especially with respect to how they view relationships. One day, Marcus is a presented with a work opportunity that would have him moving out of London, and it’s from there that the story begins…

item.title: The Headmaster 校长先生
item.description:
The Headmaster [v0.17.3.2] [Altos and Herdone]

Overview

剧情概要
  • In the not too distant future, on a small island nation, a crisis has arisen. The number of students graduating from school has fallen sharply and university places are going unfilled. Faced with the prospect of mass unemployment and potential economic disaster the government is forced to introduce emergency measures. All students over eighteen who failed or were expelled from school are to be forced back into education at a number of special facilities.
Spoiler: More
  • In The Headmaster you play an expert in young adult psychology with some unique ideas about how to tackle the crisis. After a demonstration of your theories at a teachers conference you are approached by the agent of a mysterious organisation. He invites you to interview for the position of headmaster (principal) at one of the newly founded schools for over eighteen year olds. Keen to prove yourself and your theories you gladly accept.
  • Using your unique disciplinary methods you must turn a whole school of delinquent young women into hard working and obedient students. Things will not be easy for you. You must win your colleagues to your side, cater to the unusual demands of the schools owners and deal with a troublesome government inspector.

item.title: Artifice 诡计
item.description:
Artifice [v0.1] [Duve]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Do you love theater? Ever dreamed of standing in the spotlight? Let me offer you the starring role in my little production… I promise — it’ll be a performance you’ll never forget. Artifice is the debut spectacle of our theater, exploring a world filled with intrigue, secrets, and fake smiles. It showcases the beauty of theatrical productions and why theater is so amazing.
Spoiler: More
  • The main story revolves around a protagonist who is obsessed with findings his brother — the only person who truly understands and accepts him.

And for that, he agreed to join a mysterious organization that promised to aid his search… for a price. Now, he must flawlessly carry out every mission assigned to him. Whether that means charming diplomats, outwitting rivals, or navigating the affections of those drawn to his rising star.

And you, dear audience, will witness his most daring task yet: A grand competition held by the world’s leaders to celebrate the unveiling of the Last Wonder of the World!

But beware — every spotlight casts shadows. Will the price of his mission cost him more than he’s willing to give? Or will he play his role to perfection?

Only time will tell~ Enjoy the show and remember:

“All the world’s a stage, and all the men and women merely players.”

item.title: Astreon 星宿
item.description:
Astreon [Ch.2 v0.4.5] [NoGlory]

Overview

剧情概要
  • In the year 2032, humanity stands on the brink of a technological breakthrough. A new material, developed by a group of scientists, possesses not only extraordinary strength, hyper-elasticity, and energy-saving properties, but also a unique, or rather exceptional, ability to self-repair. This capability turned the material into a regenerative pill, allowing people with limited abilities to become fully functional humans, while also making them stronger, smarter, and even extending their lifespan.
Spoiler: More
  • However, fearing the consequences of such power, the scientists decide to destroy the records, reports, and everything related to their research. They scattered, each going their own way. But as is often the case, someone found the remnants of this work. Ignoring the dangers, they decided to complete it, which eventually led to the formation of a globally banned terrorist organization called “Masquerade.” In response, leaders of major corporations launched a large-scale operation to eliminate the individual responsible and eradicate everything related to the research. You are a former soldier, unable to bear the guilt of the atrocities committed during the operation. You retreat to a remote location on the edge of the world, a small town cut off from the rest of civilization, where you planned to live a peaceful life with your wife and children, far removed from all the troubles of the past. But, as often happens, things do not go according to plan. One day, when your wife goes on a business trip to a certain research institute, she suddenly stops contacting you. In an attempt to find out what happened, you embark on a journey. Days, weeks, months, and years pass… Eventually, you come to terms with the fact that you may never see your wife again, burying all your emotions deep inside. Then, one day, your son arrives, asking for your help and with a glimmer of hope that not all is lost, that there is still a small chance to restore your peaceful life.

item.description:
V.I.R.T.U.E.S. [v17] [NoMeme]

Overview

剧情概要
  • This is a harem simulator. You, as a young capable college rich kid, versus 7 gorgeous girls with different backgrounds and personalities. The story is not only about sex, but also about romance and love fantasies. Try immerse yourself in the plots, discover more of the girls, and enjoy the feeling of developing your harem.​

Details

游戏玩法

建模引擎

PlayHome

运行引擎

Ren’Py

游戏画风

亚洲风

当前版本

17

发行日期

2023-02-17

Changelog

更新日志
  • It has been almost 1 year since we released VIRTUES v16. Back then we really thought v16 would be the last major update of VIRTUES. We used 10 weeks to create an insane amount of content (700+ new pictures and 70+ animated scenes) and thought “this is it, we’ve put a good end to the journey of VIRTUES. It is not a perfect end, there are regrets, but it is still a good end. We made it. We finish our first project instead of abandoning it halfway. There may be a v17 at some point in the future, but it will be a minor update, you know, like a DLC kind of stuff.”
  • I kept this thought even until last December, until we really began to develop this v17 update. But as soon as I re-entered the world of VIRTUES, I changed my mind. I realized there were still so many things I want to tell, so many scenes I want to make for those girls, the girls that used to be a big part of my life for more than 2 years.
  • Thus I changed my plan, and I changed it again and again during the last two months. More and more scenes were added, more and more lines were written, and less and less time I slept every day. And in the end, this update became so big that we couldn’t even imagine it. It became even bigger than v16. It has more than 900+ new pictures and 70+ animated scenes, with the greatest amount of text.
  • V17 is the last major update of VIRTUES. It is the biggest update we’ve ever made, and maybe the lewdest one as well. Still, it is not a perfect end and there are regrets, but we have done our best and we hope you will enjoy our hard work.
  • I will write a post as the final summary of the journey of VIRTUES in a few days. As for now, let’s just take a brief look at what’s new in the update:
  • Irene’s solo ending
  • The silver kitten finally got her solo ending. Her ending contains two long branches, and each of them leads to a unique happy end. You will help this girl solve her confusion and decide the path of her future. Elisa’s solo ending
  • Just like her little daughter, this blonde milf’s solo ending also contains two long branches. This poor lady was deeply wounded from her previous marriage and she really needs you to take her away from the curse from her past.
  • The afterstory of your harem
  • There will be 4 major parts of your harem’s afterstory: Vera’s college dream, Uno’s real family, Senning’s daily life after her mother left the country, and the Shinyrost mother&daughter’s male worship. Each of them contains a tremendous amount of harem scenes.

Developer（入正地址）

Patreon Discord Itch.io

落谦酱便利贴

PS
  • 很经典的一个游戏，CG放到现在依旧能打，而且瑟瑟剧情描写的很细腻，好像都有反差的那种，不愧是老艺术家的从容。
  • 当然，这游戏是沙盒的，所以会很多不能提取的文本，如果你遇到有些英文句子，影响到你游玩，请在博客留言，并且附上原文句子，我再去vscode上找到源码，再去通过ai汉化。

item.title: Deviant Anomalies 极度异常
item.description:
Deviant Anomalies [v0.9.5] [MoolahMilk]

Overview

剧情概要
  • A mysterious snowstorm engulfs the city and changes your life forever. Ever since the bizarre snowstorm, reports of supernatural occurrences begin to surface and crime rates are rising at an exponential level. Netherhelm is in chaos. YOU, fresh out of college and armed with a fancy degree in Criminal Psychology, decide to join law enforcement as a rookie detective. With a deep seated obsession to unravel the mysteries of the snowstorm, you solve case after case as you trudge along the strings of fate towards your final destiny.
剧情概要
  • Solve baffling cases, recruit Supernatural Anomalies into your team and help them control their newfound powers. The more uninhibited their minds are, the more their powers grow. Will you train these beautiful women with trust and respect? Or will you break their minds through sheer depravity and corruption? Will you build a team of based on the foundations of friendship and love? Or will you create a harem of cock-worshipping slaves who submit to your every whim and desire?
  • Either way, you are in a race against time. You better be ready, for The Watchmaker is coming. High quality renders with fully animated lewd scenes and immersive gameplay. The best is yet to come.

item.title: The Arson Betrayal 纵火背叛
item.description:
The Arson Betrayal [v0.8.0] [Crispy Chicken Productions]

Overview

剧情概要
  • The Arson Betrayal puts you in the shoes of Leo Somerfort (or any name you want). With only an apartment in Ablesmith City and enough cash to pay the bills for a few months, you’ve been working at a café, hoping to save enough money to be able to go to college. But one fateful encounter plunges you into the middle of a conspiracy filled with lies, betrayal, and violence.
  • “Watch your back. Trust no one.”
  • “Now it begins.”
  • Synopsis
剧情概要
  • The Arson Betrayal is first and foremost a Harem game, centered around a story-focused action-thriller visual novel.
  • Players are given the opportunity to choose which girls they wish to pursue a relationship with (or even none at all), as they spiral down towards the center of a deadly conspiracy.
  • As the story goes, you’ll discover the girls’ different kinks and be given the chance to determine how your relationship with them progresses, romantically or otherwise.
  • A majority of your choices and conversations with characters throughout the story are remembered and may affect the story as you go forward.

item.title: Apocalypse 2059 启示录2059
item.description:
Apocalypse 2059 [v0.3 Special] [BigH4nd.Inc]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Apocalypse 2059 Welcome to the savage world of 2059, where survival is a daily struggle and civilization is nothing but a distant memory. The World That Was In 2030, an event known as “The Cataclysm” forever changed the face of Earth. Nuclear weapons claimed lives in an instant, plunging the world into a devastating nuclear winter that lasted over a decade. Civilization, law, and morality crumbled into dust. The surface became an inferno, forcing what little plant life remained to retreat underground. For the few who survived, existence became a constant battle against extinction. Twenty years have passed. The pre-war generation grows old, while a new generation rises, knowing nothing of the world that came before.
Spoiler
  • Your Story Begins The story takes place in the year 2059. You, the protagonist, have been living in solitude in a shelter since your birth. These peaceful days are changed by the appearance of a mysterious woman. At her urgent request, you’ll embark on a perilous journey across the savage lands of what was once civilization. Unforgettable Characters Your path will cross with unique survivors, each shaped by the merciless world they inhabit: A reckless and confident villain with her own agenda A young, sensitive tribal leader struggling to protect her people A ruthless warlord carving out her empire silver-tongued treasure hunter seeking fortune in the ruins

item.title: Between Humanity 人类之间
item.description:
Between Humanity [v0.3.3] [DebatingPanda]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Between Humanity takes you on a journey into a potential future that borders on dystopia. Set just five years ahead, you, as the protagonist, were just an ordinary student until one day you find yourself waking up in a hospital room.
  • All memories of why you ended up there are blurred in the depths of your mind. But as soon as you try to go back to your daily life, you realize that something is fundamentally different. You are invited to live in your best friend’s house, where you will also be sharing the space with her mother and sister, each of whom has their own set of problems and daily struggles. What could possibly go wrong with that?
  • With every decision you make, you not only change your own life but also that of your friends and loved ones. It’s in your hands which game you want to play.​

Overview

剧情概要
  • You transfer to a university for your sophomore year to start life with a clean slate. A new city, new people, new - - opportunities—it seems like everything is falling into place perfectly.
  • But already in the first week, something starts to go wrong.
  • Strangers stare at you too intently.
  • Conversations overheard by chance, cut short when you approach.
  • Suspicious documents that shouldn’t exist.
  • This university has dark secrets. Some students know more than they let on. Teachers pretend not to notice anything. And those who ask too many questions… disappear.
  • Someone is watching you.

item.title: Agent17 特工17
item.description:
Agent17 [v0.26.10] [HEXATAIL]

Overview

剧情概要
  • You are an ordinary-looking pervert with average grades, blending into the background at school without anyone paying much attention to you. Occasionally, you may face bullying from troublemakers, possibly even being robbed or coerced into doing their bidding. However, one fateful day while heading home, you stumble upon a damaged phone. The phone initiated transformation in your life.
Spoiler: More

  • This phone has the power to solve all your problems. Contrary to popular belief, an unknown individual called Agent17 obeys the commands of whoever picks up the phone, allowing you to instruct her to carry out any task. Suddenly, your life takes a dramatic turn for the better. You triumph over the bullies who tormented you, and you exact revenge on the teachers and principals who held you in contempt.

  • The mundane school life that once held no interest for you begins to change as you start interacting with a multitude of talented and captivating individuals. As your connections deepen, you gradually uncover their hidden secrets. With the formidable abilities of Agent17 at your disposal, you also delve into their unknown mysteries. Moreover, you realize that your life is brimming with countless fascinating discoveries awaiting your exploration.

item.title: Cross Realms 跨界
item.description:
Cross Realms [v0.4Public] [DuskDuck]

Overview

剧情概要
  • On the first day of your college life, you and a group of friends are sucked into a vortex. When you wake up, you realize you’re in a foreign place - this is not Earth. As you explore this new world, you discover it’s a Qi cultivation realm, where power determines everything.
Spoiler

  • There are nine Realms, each controlled by a dominant race: Humans, Demons, Deities, Spiritual Beasts, and more. Each Realm has a “spring” - a flow of Qi energy harvested from the Void, the space between Realms. Because of these springs, peace between the Realms is fragile and rarely lasts long. You arrive during the longest period of peace ever known, but how long will this so-called ‘peace’ really last?

  • As your journey continues, you uncover more secrets about these Realms. Someone in the shadows has been plotting and orchestrating your arrival. Will you be able to stand up for yourself in a world where many see you as nothing more than a useless ant?

  • The answer are yours to find.

item.title: Wild Cats 野猫
item.description:
Wild Cats [v0.3 Public] [LopaPhi]

Overview

剧情概要
  • You are a highly anticipated up and coming volleyball star. Or rather, you were up until you destroyed your shoulder and your prospects along with it by overworking yourself. Now you’re just a nobody who drowned your sorrows away with a series of poor life choices.
Spoiler

  • This story takes place after a wake up call following a year of wallowing in despair with a life that spiralled downhill under the shadow of the star volleyball prospect you once were. You have just received a vague invitation for a meeting from the Dean of Baskerville State University, a highly prestigious university, regarding a potential scholarship when no other universities would give the current you a second glance.

  • The condition of this scholarship however would turn out to be facing your demons as you return to the sport you turned your back on in a new role, becoming the coach of the school’s women’s volleyball team.

  • But little did you know that facing your demons would be the easiest part of this task as the team is riddled with fatal problems, each threatening to end your scholarship left, right, and centre! Yet by earnestly facing these girls and their issues with your eyes wide open, you might just end up growing in a way you never thought you would. Are you ready to coach the BSU Wild Cats and lead them to victory?
